about.title: About
about.text: UniversalSaver started as a university project and grew into a full idea. Here you can keep the films, series and everything else you have watched or plan to watch.
about.productsText: Our products include a Telegram bot, a website, a mobile app and a desktop app. You can preview their design with the buttons below.

film.description: Save your favorite films and come back to them whenever you like. All your impressions in one place.

series.description: Hooked on a series? Save it to your collection and come back for new impressions!

anime.description: Enjoying anime? Save it to your collection and explore new horizons!

cartoon.description: Save your favorite cartoons and build a collection of your own!

game.description: Save your favorite games and get the most out of them!
